title: Great Barrier Reef Bleaching Now Returns Every 2 Years
hook: Reef bleaching now returns about every 2 years.
closing: Each bleaching wave now arrives before the reef can fully recover.
question: Can the reef keep up?

segments.say: The reef has already suffered 3 bleaching events this decade. What was rare became routine.
The average gap shrank to 2 years. The reef barely catches its breath.
A reef typically needs 10 years to recover. New bleaching arrives far too soon.
